description: List posts filtered by status, author, search, and category, ordered by newest.

status.description: Optional post status to filter by (defaults to 'publish').

author.description: Optional author id to filter posts by.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive search over post title and content.

categories.description: Optional category id that returned posts must belong to.

per_page.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of post objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new post with title, content, status, author, and taxonomy assignments.

categories.description: Optional list of category ids to assign.

tags.description: Optional list of tag ids to assign.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created post object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single post by its numeric id.

post_id.description: The unique numeric id of the post.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the post object; on failure (post not found), output contains a WordPress error object.

description: Update fields of an existing post by its numeric id.

post_id.description: The unique numeric id of the post to update.

categories.description: Optional new list of category ids.

tags.description: Optional new list of tag ids.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated post object; on failure (post not found), output contains a WordPress error object.

description: Delete a post by its numeric id.

post_id.description: The unique numeric id of the post to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms deletion with the removed post; on failure (post not found), output contains a WordPress error object.

description: List pages filtered by status, ordered by newest.

per_page.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of page objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of category objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of tag objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List comments filtered by post and status, ordered by date.

post.description: Optional post id to filter comments by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of comment objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Create a new approved comment on a post.

post.description: The id of the post being commented on.

parent.description: Optional parent comment id for threaded replies (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created comment object; on failure (post not found), output contains a WordPress error object.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of media objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of user objects; on failure, output contains an error message.
